title: DeliveryFailure
description: Nonfatal correlated delivery failure returned only over reverse labelBindings.

x-agp.mechanics: Nonfatal correlated delivery failure returned only over reverse labelBindings.
x-agp.rationale: A sovereign contract gives validators and consumers one stable reasoning boundary.
x-agp.consequence: Accepting another shape would make peer interpretation or ownership ambiguous.
